result.instructions: Tools for Canny, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which feature requests have the most votes this month?"; "Show every post on the Feature Requests board that is still open."; "Move the post about SSO to planned and tell the voters.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Canny data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run canny_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run canny_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run canny_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. canny_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: canny_list_boards
tools.title: List boards
tools.description: List every feedback board in the Canny workspace (for example Feature Requests). Start here to get board ids for other tools. Canny API: POST /api/v1/boards/list.

tools.name: canny_retrieve_board
tools.title: Get a board
tools.description: Get one board: name, post count, privacy and URL. Canny API: POST /api/v1/boards/retrieve.

tools.name: canny_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List categories, optionally for one board. Canny API: POST /api/v1/categories/list.

limit.description: How many to return (1-10000). Default 10 when not set.

tools.name: canny_list_tags
tools.title: List tags
tools.description: List tags, optionally for one board. Canny API: POST /api/v1/tags/list.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

tools.name: canny_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List customer groups (segments of companies or users). Cursor-paged. Canny API: POST /api/v1/groups/list.

limit.description: How many groups to return (1-100). Default 50.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response (cursor-paged lists only).

tools.name: canny_list_posts
tools.title: List posts
tools.description: List feedback posts (feature requests) with status, score and comment count. Filter by board, author, company, tags, status or search text. Canny API: POST /api/v1/posts/list (skip pagination).

author_id.description: Only posts by this author id.

company_id.description: Only posts by users of this company (your company id).

tag_ids.description: Only posts with at least one of these tag ids.

search.description: Only posts that match this text.

sort.description: Sort order. Default is the Canny default order.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

skip.description: How many posts to skip (skip pagination).

tools.name: canny_retrieve_post
tools.title: Get a post
tools.description: Get one feedback post with its details, status, score, tags, ETA and roadmaps. Canny API: POST /api/v1/posts/retrieve.

tools.name: canny_list_comments
tools.title: List comments
tools.description: List portal comments, optionally for one post, board, author or company. Cursor-paged. Canny API: POST /api/v2/comments/list.

post_id.description: Only comments on this post id.

author_id.description: Only comments by this author id.

company_id.description: Only comments by users of this company.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response (cursor-paged lists only).

tools.name: canny_list_votes
tools.title: List votes
tools.description: List votes, newest first. Filter by post, board, user or company. Cursor-paged. Canny API: POST /api/v2/votes/list.

post_id.description: Only votes on this post id.

user_id.description: Only votes by this user id.

company_id.description: Only votes by users of this company.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response (cursor-paged lists only).

tools.name: canny_list_status_changes
tools.title: List status changes
tools.description: List post status changes (for example open to planned), newest first. Cursor-paged. Canny API: POST /api/v2/status_changes/list.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response (cursor-paged lists only).

tools.name: canny_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List end-users in the workspace. Cursor-paged. Canny API: POST /api/v2/users/list.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response (cursor-paged lists only).

tools.name: canny_retrieve_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one end-user by Canny id, your own user id, or email. Give exactly one. Canny API: POST /api/v1/users/retrieve.

user_id.description: The user's id in your own application.

tools.name: canny_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List companies (customer accounts) with name, domain, MRR and custom fields. Search by name or segment. Cursor-paged. Canny API: POST /api/v2/companies/list.

search.description: Only companies whose name contains this text.

segment.description: URL name of a segment to filter by.

limit.description: How many to return (1-100). Default 10 when not set.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous page's response (cursor-paged lists only).

tools.name: canny_list_changelog_entries
tools.title: List changelog entries
tools.description: List changelog entries (release notes): draft, scheduled or published, with type new, improved or fixed. Canny API: POST /api/v1/entries/list.

label_ids.description: Only entries with at least one of these label ids.

limit.description: How many to return (1-10000). Default 10 when not set.

skip.description: How many entries to skip (up to 1000).

tools.name: canny_create_post
tools.title: Create a post
tools.description: Create a new feedback post on a board, as a user (author_id). It is visible to other users of the portal. Canny API: POST /api/v1/posts/create.

board_id.description: Board id to post on (from canny_list_boards).

author_id.description: Canny user id of the post's author (from canny_list_users or canny_retrieve_user).

owner_id.description: User id of the person responsible for the work.

by_id.description: Admin id who creates the post on behalf of the author (shown in the post).

tools.name: canny_change_post_status
tools.title: Change a post's status
tools.description: Set a post's status, for example 'planned' or 'complete'. Logged under the admin who changes it (changer_id). Setting the same status again changes nothing. Canny API: POST /api/v1/posts/change_status.

status.description: New status: 'open', 'under review', 'planned', 'in progress', 'complete', 'closed', or a custom status.

changer_id.description: Admin user id recorded as making the change.

should_notify_voters.description: True emails the non-admin voters about the change. False changes the status silently.

comment.description: Comment shown with the status change.

tools.name: canny_create_comment
tools.title: Add a comment to a post
tools.description: Add a portal comment to a post, as a user (author_id). Set internal=true for an admin-only comment. Canny API: POST /api/v1/comments/create.

post_id.description: Post id to comment on (from canny_list_posts).

author_id.description: Canny user id of the comment's author.

parent_id.description: Id of the comment this replies to.

internal.description: True makes the comment visible to admins only.

should_notify_voters.description: True emails the post's voters about the comment.

annotations.title: Add a comment to a post
